skill.name: longbridge-intel
skill.description: Analyze stocks, ETFs, sectors, catalysts, market flows, and disruptive innovation themes with structured Longbridge market intelligence workflows.
skill.summary: Turn Longbridge market data into focused screens, briefings, event analysis, and thematic research.
skill.author: longbridge

security_audit.summary: All 26 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown formatting or financial terminology. No Ruby or shell backtick execution appears at the cited lines. The catalyst workflow requests private positions and account changes despite read-only, no-login metadata.

remediation.issue: Undeclared account access and state changes in the catalyst workflow
remediation.suggestion: Remove account mutations, or declare authentication and write permissions. Require explicit confirmation before each change and make position access optional.

semantic_findings.title: Undeclared Account Data Access and State Changes
semantic_findings.description: The catalyst workflow reads positions and watchlists, changes watchlist membership, and updates preferences. These actions conflict with read-only, no-login metadata.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The metadata explicitly declares read-only, no-login behavior, while the catalyst reference explicitly requests private positions and account changes.

content.value_statement: Market signals are fragmented across screeners, news, flows, and sector data. This skill organizes Longbridge data into focused market intelligence and research workflows.
actual_capabilities: Screen stocks with saved strategies or custom indicator ranges.
Compare popularity rankings, unusual quotes, and news-linked top movers.
List and sort index or ETF constituents.
Create morning briefs, catalyst scans, and event-driven research summaries.
Analyze ETF flows, liquidity, tracking, and sector rotation.
Apply structured frameworks for industries, supply chains, microstructure, and disruptive innovation.
limitations: Most workflows require the Longbridge CLI or an available Longbridge MCP service.
Several reference links point to files that are not included in this package.
Market coverage and freshness depend on Longbridge data availability.
Catalyst workflows may require authenticated watchlist and position access despite the package metadata.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Daily Market Brief
use_cases.description: Summarize overnight moves, watchlist catalysts, events, and capital flows before the trading session.

use_cases.title: Research an Industry Theme
use_cases.description: Map sector leaders, valuation context, supply chains, and disruptive innovation drivers.

use_cases.title: Monitor Portfolio Catalysts
use_cases.description: Track news, filings, flows, and company events across a selected watchlist.

prompt_templates.title: Review Top Movers

prompt_templates.title: Compare Sector Rotation
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare US sector momentum, capital flows, and valuation context. Identify strengthening and weakening sectors with supporting evidence.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Innovation Scenario
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate [TICKER] with the disruptive innovation framework. Show suitability, TAM, cost trends, three scenarios, risks, and source reconciliation.

best_practices: Provide market-qualified symbols and the relevant exchange.
State the market, date, horizon, and preferred output language.
Treat model scenarios as research inputs and verify time-sensitive data.
anti_patterns: Do not treat popularity rankings as investment recommendations.
Do not request a confident target when required inputs are missing.
Do not combine markets or time periods without labeling them.

faq.question: Which markets does this skill cover?
faq.answer: Its workflows reference US, Hong Kong, mainland China, and Singapore markets. Availability varies by command and data source.

faq.question: Does it place trades?
faq.answer: No trading workflow is documented. It provides research, screening, monitoring, and analytical summaries.

faq.question: Does it require a Longbridge account?
faq.answer: Public CLI commands are described as login-free. Watchlist, position, or preference workflows may require authentication.

faq.question: Can it provide investment advice?
faq.answer: It produces research frameworks and scenarios, not personalized investment advice. Users should evaluate conclusions against their own risk tolerance.

faq.question: What happens when the CLI is unavailable?
faq.answer: The skill directs the agent to use a Longbridge MCP service. Some workflows also allow limited web search.

faq.question: Can it analyze ETFs and sectors?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes ETF holdings, liquidity, tracking, fund flow, sector rotation, and industry research workflows.
